item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs gsang ba thugs kyi brnag pa khro bo gsang thus
item.coloph: dong ra khyung rdzong nas sprul sku gyer mi nyi 'od kyis/ sa pho byi lo la rnyed pa'o/ rma ston srid 'dzin la/ rong gi tsa ri'i chu dron du/rgun (dgun) zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad snga gro la/ dbang bskur shog ser dngos grub tu gtad de/ bla ma rma ston gyi thugs dam yi dam/ 'di la sgrub pa thim par mdzad/ rim gyis brgyud nas slob dpon gnyos la grags 'bum bdag gis zhus so/ slob dpon brgyud pa rnams la kho bo bdag gis zhus te dag go//
